tasks.description: Propose exactly three concise implementation strategies labeled A, B, and C. Explain the main benefit and risk of each.
Use typed Jev judgments to choose and score the generated candidates.

state.goal: Prefer a practical, reversible strategy with a strong quality-to-cost ratio.

best_candidate.instructions: Which labeled candidate best satisfies the goal?

criteria.a: Candidate A in the supplied dependency output
criteria.b: Candidate B in the supplied dependency output
criteria.c: Candidate C in the supplied dependency output

is_reversible.instructions: The best candidate can be reversed without significant loss.

quality_cost_balance.instructions: Rate the best candidate's quality-to-cost balance.
